name: radlit9-benchmark
description:
\
RadLIT-9 is a retrieval benchmark for evaluating embedding models on radiology education content.
It comprises 420 multiple-choice questions derived from 36 peer-reviewed, open-access (CC-BY 4.0)
review articles spanning nine ABR (American Board of Radiology) subspecialties.

Version 1.1 includes data quality improvements: removal of 9 contaminated articles, relabeling
of 5 mislabeled articles, and balancing to ~50 questions per subspecialty.
reputation: A niche, specialized benchmark used by researchers evaluating embedding models for radiology education; moderate adoption in medical ML research.
